description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/64971540), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%84%88%EB%A1%9C-%EC%A0%96%EB%8A%94-%EB%B0%A4/4209)

**Official Translations:**     
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/177833) 

Unnamed actress Kim Yeong-won. Her long-desired role was snatched away by an old rival. And she did so with the backing of a wealthy sponsor. Determined not to let it go, Yeong-won chased after her, where she met the man known as her ‘sponsor’ and, in a fit of anger, kissed him forcefully. But it turned out this man was not the ‘sponsor’ at all. He was a much scarier man.
